name: Cabin in the Woods: PSX Horror
description: An original PSX-style cabin and mixed woodland, with reusable furnishings, tools, weapons, vegetation, a Stone Golem and an articulated spider.
devices: Desktop keyboard and mouse. Requires WebGPU. Mobile play is not qualified.

posters.alt: The cabin and surrounding pine and birch woodland, with a warm porch light
The furnished cabin interior, with dining table, boarded windows and a burning fireplace
